description: Comprehensive SEO, marketing, and LLM data APIs providing SERP, keyword, backlink, and domain analytics data.
auth_notes: Basic HTTP authentication using login (email) and password (API password) in request headers.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up instantly for an account with $1 trial credits to test the API via pay-as-you-go pricing.
api_notes: Extensive coverage of SERP, keywords data, backlinks, on-page SEO, domain analytics, merchant data, and AI/LLM search scraping.
mcp_notes: Official TypeScript-based Model Context Protocol server published in their GitHub organization (mcp-server-typescript).
rationale: Public REST APIs are fully documented with instant self-service account registration providing trial credits and an official MCP server.
